statement: After solving D6=0 over Q(tau)[d]/(q4(d,tau)), prove uniformly that lower binary terms cannot cancel the D5 obstruction on the explicit F4 weighted-inflection family, and then classify the remaining ramification-degree-at-least-four and fixed-component boundary cases.
title: Can the F4 Compatibility Check Close Coprime Binary Quartic Pencils?
